svg.text: Up to sixteen reflective IR channels on a shared pulsed LED bus, digitised on the board and read over SPI.
SPI crossing and the two converters
GND1 and GND2 on the one ground pour
MISO and ADC-DOUT run teal, MOSI runs green, and SCK, the chip selects and CLOCK stay purple.
Channel n of sixteen, n = 1 … 16. All sixteen identical.
Pin 1 supply, Pin 2 the phototransistor emitter,
Pin 3 the LED cathode. No ground runs to the sensor.
one switch for all sixteen emitters
Supply: 3.3 V from the D24V5F3, which sits off this board; on the bench the Teensy’s 3V3 pin feeds J-PWR
3V3 to Pin 1 of every sensor board, and to U3
3V3 is the board rail at J-PWR. 3V3_ADC is that rail behind R39, 66 mV lower at the converters’ 1.4 mA, and it is what VREF measures against.
Placement, the groups that stay together and how close: see mainboard-placement.svg
